auth.notes: App gives the user full access to all data without any authentication.

error_format.notes: Errors are flashed to the session and displayed in Edge templates via flash messages. Form validation uses AdonisJS validator with field-level error messages.

pagination.notes: As the app scales, pagination can be added via server-side route params (e.g., ?page=2).

naming_conventions.notes: AdonisJS Lucid model names are PascalCase singular (Task, Group). Route paths use kebab-case (/task-list, /group-form).

other_decisions: All timestamps stored as UTC via Lucid ORM auto-timestamps
Soft-delete via deleted_at column on Task and Group entities
SQLite database file stored at database/sqlite/db.sqlite
